title: FX216 one address per page: the overview
caption: Five steps, in order: Google is told which address is each page's original, and is sent there from any other.

cards.title: FX216 One address per page
cards.text: Every page has one address Google reads as the original, so its copies stop competing.

cards.title: 1. Canonical is the page
cards.text: A section's address names its page as the original.

cards.title: 2. Sitemaps list pages
cards.text: Both sitemaps list one address per page.

cards.title: 3. The site's address
cards.text: One setting names where each site lives.

cards.title: 4. Other hosts sent on
cards.text: A page on www or any other host answers 301.

cards.title: 5. Apps and docs
cards.text: Both apps set it; the new ADR amends 0107 and 0109.
